name: @ecopages/radiant-monorepo
description: A minimalist web component library designed for simplicity and flexibility

scripts.clean: clear && pnpm dlx npkill -D -y && rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm install
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/jsx/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/signals/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/radiant/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/vite-plugin-radiant/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p playground/vite/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p playground/vite-nitro/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/docs/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:all: pnpm --filter @ecopages/signals build:lib && pnpm --filter @ecopages/jsx build:lib && pnpm --filter @ecopages/radiant build:lib && pnpm --filter @ecopages/vite-plugin-radiant build:lib && pnpm --filter @ecopages/radiant-ui build:lib
scripts.test:all: pnpm --filter @ecopages/jsx test:lib && pnpm --filter @ecopages/signals test:lib && pnpm --filter @ecopages/radiant test:lib && pnpm --filter @ecopages/vite-plugin-radiant test:lib && pnpm --filter radiant-docs test:e2e && pnpm --filter kitchen-sink-vite-nitro test:e2e && pnpm --filter playground-vite test:e2e && pnpm run size:check
scripts.prerelease: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:all && pnpm run test:all
scripts.dev:playground-vite: pnpm --filter playground-vite dev & pnpm run watch:lib
scripts.dev:kitchen-sink-vite-nitro: pnpm --filter kitchen-sink-vite-nitro dev & pnpm run watch:lib
